description: This Java class `CollectionSheetGenerateCommandFromApiJsonDeserializer` handles JSON deserialization and validation for collection sheet generation commands in the Fineract project. It validates input JSON payloads for different collection sheet generation scenarios, checking required fields, parameter support, and data correctness.

classes.name: CollectionSheetGenerateCommandFromApiJsonDeserializer
classes.description: Main class responsible for deserializing and validating JSON requests for collection sheet generation. Supports validation for general collection sheet creation and individual collection sheet scenarios.

methods.name: validateForGenerateCollectionSheet
methods.description: Validates JSON payload for generating a collection sheet, ensuring required fields like transaction date and calendar ID are present and correctly formatted.

methods.name: validateForGenerateCollectionSheetOfIndividuals
methods.description: Validates JSON payload for generating individual collection sheets, checking additional parameters like office and staff IDs.
